fieldValues.title: Reporting and minutes
fieldValues.article_text: The group keeps its minutes in its decision log (container WG Third-party ready). A task gets no decision record; close an issue only with a merged PR. A within-mandate decision that closes options is created proposed by the Builder, then ratified by the Reviewer with a comment under its own actor. Every escalation is a proposed decision created by the Steward, opening with the problem statement; only the owner moves it to ratified. The Steward is the only member who opens escalations.
fieldValues.rationale: Minutes are the audit trail for a mandate that rests on testimony, since one GitHub identity does every merge.
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Owner only: an amendment needs a new owner-ratified decision.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent testimony until the owner ratifies the charter decision.
